title: K and K+Si medium preparation
author: Roscoff Culture Collection
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s34egqw
materials: f/2 Vitamin solution In 100mL of distilled water, dissolve 0,05g of biotin (vit. H) and 0,05g of cyanocobalamin (vit. B 12 ) = solution A In 0,5mL of solution A, add 0,05g of thiamine HCl (vit. B 1 ) and complete final volume to 50mL of distilled water Filter sterilize on Millipore 0,22µm Store in refrigerator or freezer

steps.title: Filter seawater
steps.instruction: Filter 1 L of old seawater (minimum two‑month storage) first through a prefilter and then through a 0.2 µm filter.

steps.title: Heat seawater
steps.instruction: Heat the filtered seawater for 20 minutes at 100 °C.

steps.title: Add autoclaved nutrients
steps.instruction: Under a laminar flow hood, add the autoclaved nutrient mixture (excluding vitamin) to the heated seawater.

steps.title: Prepare K trace metal solution
steps.instruction: To 900 mL of distilled H₂O add the K Trace Metal Solution components, then bring the volume up to 1.0 L with additional H₂O and heat until fully dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Add K Trace Metal Solution components to 900 mL H₂O.
Adjust volume to 1.0 L with H₂O.
Heat the mixture to dissolve all components.

steps.title: Final filtration
steps.instruction: Filter the completed medium through a 0.2 µm filter.
